dedupe_keys.name: renewable electrified cement production flexibility and economic competitiveness

description: A Politecnico di Milano researcher publishes GAMS optimisation files for a partly electrified cement plant in Sicily. Zenodo provides model text files, Excel inputs and hourly result workbooks under CC BY 4.0. The deposited scenarios compare inflexible and flexible operation over short- and long-term economic assumptions. The model can test electricity-demand shifting and investment tradeoffs for industrial decarbonisation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these GAMS files. Coverage is the specified Sicily plant configuration and scenario assumptions, not observed dispatch at all cement works. A limitation is that supplementary hourly outcomes are generated by the author model and are not independent validation. Prices, process constraints and grid conditions may change the ranking of scenarios. GAMS availability and solver settings may affect reuse. No GAMS file or workbook was downloaded, no solver was run and the reported hourly balances were not recalculated.
